# KINETIC: AI Rep Counter

> KINETIC: AI Rep Counter is a free Android app that uses your phone camera to count reps for 11 exercises. Pose detection runs on-device; video is never uploaded.

Key facts:
- Platform: Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lencoder.sport.ai). No iOS version yet.
- Price: free, no ads.
- Counts 11 exercises from joint angles measured with the phone camera (Google ML Kit pose detection, on-device).
- Video is never recorded or uploaded. Workout records are stored only on the phone, per Google account; guest mode saves nothing.
- Works offline. Languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.
- Developer: shaolei wang (leishaolen@gmail.com).

## Exercises
- [Push-up counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/push-up-counter/): elbow angle, 90° or less counts
- [Squat counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/squat-counter/): knee angle, 110° or less, then back to 160°
- [Lunge counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/lunge-counter/): knee angle, 100° or less, then back to 160°
- [Sit-up counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/sit-up-counter/): hip angle, 70° or less, then back to 120°
- [Jumping jack counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/jumping-jack-counter/): shoulder angle, 150° or more, then back to 40°
- [Glute bridge counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/glute-bridge-counter/): hip angle, 165° or more, then back to 140°
- [Leg raise counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/leg-raise-counter/): hip angle, 100° or less, then back to 160°
- [Pull-up counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/pull-up-counter/): elbow angle, 70° or less, then back to 150°
- [Bicep curl counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/bicep-curl-counter/): elbow angle, 50° or less, then back to 150°
- [Lateral raise counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/lateral-raise-counter/): shoulder angle, 80° or more, then back to 30°
- [Overhead press counter](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/exercises/shoulder-press-counter/): elbow angle, 160° or more, then back to 90°

## Guides
- [Where to put your phone](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/guides/phone-placement/): Phone setup for all 11 exercises, plus lighting tips.
- [How on-device pose detection works](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/guides/on-device-pose-detection/): What happens to each camera frame, and what (little) leaves your phone.
- [100 push-ups a day](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/guides/100-push-ups-a-day/): Split it into sets, build up week by week, track it automatically.
- [30-day squat challenge](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/guides/30-day-squat-challenge/): A day-by-day plan from 20 to 130 squats, with a rest day every fourth day.
- [Rep counter apps compared](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/guides/rep-counter-apps-compared/): Six camera rep counters side by side: platform, price, exercises and privacy.
- [FAQ](https://kinetic.lencoder.com/faq/)
